The independent colony return covers Fiji and Rotuma. Federico–Tena also includes New Caledonia, New Hebrides, eastern New Guinea and Solomon Islands in Melanesia. Subtracting the opening figure cannot identify any of those populations.

The adopted statistical subdivisions lie within the older India account. Their common-area census basis omits Aden and leaves incompletely mapped frontier areas in the legacy balance. The population of the full research area and the opening subdivisions cannot yield a geographic residual.

The opening explicitly covers Mauritius and Rodrigues. The study refers to the Kuczynski series for Mauritius; the inclusion of Rodrigues in its control has not been established from the cited study text. The Seychelles have a separate research series.

The opening uses separate annual estimates for the Cape and for Natal and Zululand before the 1903 transfer from Transvaal.
